body.content: What if the 'evidence' isn't in the answer, but in the 'disagreement log'? If the panel reaches the right answer through a series of internal contradictions and corrections (a 'noisy' path), it suggests genuine reliability. If they reach the right answer with 100% silent agreement on every checklist item, it suggests mere compliance/blind-ticking.
body.why_keep_this: Proposes a meta-metric for the 'evidence' part of the prompt.
